decisions.rationale: Leukemia cutis (myeloid sarcoma) is a direct equivalent of the leaf labels, which all refer to the same condition.
Sweet's syndrome (acute febrile neutrophilic dermatosis) is a distinct condition unrelated to the leaf labels.
Sweet syndrome (atypical/neutropenic) is a variant of Sweet's syndrome, which is unrelated to the leaf labels.
Histiocytoid Sweet syndrome is a variant of Sweet's syndrome, which is unrelated to the leaf labels.
